summary: 19 batches (~146 WQ simulations). D0 submit bar = Sharpe>2.0 & Fitness>1.3 (delay-driven, confirmed). Risk-model neutralizations (STATISTICAL/CROWDING/FAST/SLOW) are LOCKED on this account tier -> the standard lever to reach D0 Sharpe 2.0 is unavailable. Best clean, simple, economic, non-IV D0 factor caps at Sharpe ~1.81-1.83 (passes EVERY submit check except the steep delay-0 2.0 Sharpe bar). The SAME factor at delay=1 passes ALL submit checks.
factor_economics: Cross-sectional VALUE (sales/price + EBIT/price + gross-profitability quality) MINUS short-horizon price OVERREACTION/REVERSAL (de-meaned price ts_av_diff + price-volume correlation + risk-adjusted reversal). Long cheap+profitable+oversold names, short expensive+over-extended names. Regularized with gaussian-quantile + subindustry group_zscore + ts_backfill. No IV / option fields.

best_D0.expression: subtract(add(add(group_zscore(quantile(ts_backfill(divide(sales, cap), 22), driver=gaussian), subindustry), group_zscore(quantile(ts_backfill(divide(est_ebit, cap), 22), driver=gaussian), subindustry)), group_zscore(quantile(ts_backfill(divide(est_grossincome, est_tot_assets), 22), driver=gaussian), subindustry)), add(add(group_zscore(quantile(ts_av_diff(close, 15), driver=gaussian), subindustry), group_zscore(quantile(ts_corr(close, volume, 15), driver=gaussian), subindustry)), group_zscore(quantile(divide(ts_av_diff(close, 15), ts_std_dev(returns, 30)), driver=gaussian), subindustry)))

submittable_delay1.expression: subtract(add(add(group_zscore(quantile(ts_backfill(divide(sales, cap), 22), driver=gaussian), subindustry), group_zscore(quantile(ts_backfill(divide(est_ebit, cap), 22), driver=gaussian), subindustry)), group_zscore(quantile(ts_backfill(divide(est_grossincome, est_tot_assets), 22), driver=gaussian), subindustry)), add(add(group_zscore(quantile(ts_av_diff(close, 15), driver=gaussian), subindustry), group_zscore(quantile(ts_corr(close, volume, 15), driver=gaussian), subindustry)), group_zscore(quantile(divide(ts_av_diff(close, 15), ts_std_dev(returns, 30)), driver=gaussian), subindustry)))
